Definition: of uncertain derivation; the "hyacinth" or "jacinth", i.e. some gem of a deep blue color, probably the zirkon:-- jacinth.
BiblicalUsage: hyákinthos is a plain word for the jacinth, a precious stone. In Revelation 21:20, the text says "a jacinth."
TheologicalSignificance: I read hyákinthos plainly — it means the jacinth, a precious stone, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
